title: SCA Minhag of the Week 269: "Tefilin in Minhah of a Fast Day on Friday Part 2"

chapters.title: Introduction and Chacham Baruch Ben Haim
chapters.about: Asara Betevet on a Friday and Chacham Baruch Ben Haim's instruction to wear tefillin

chapters.title: Tzadik Veshalom and Mekubalim
chapters.about: Rabbi Eliyahu Mishaan, Tzadik Veshalom, and Rabbi Chayim Hakohen

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the community custom of wearing tefillin during Minhah when Asara Betevet falls on a Friday. He references Chacham Baruch Ben Haim, the book Tzadik Veshalom, Rabbi Chayim Hakohen, and sources from Halab.
questions: Do we wear tefillin at Minhah when Asara Betevet falls on a Friday?
What did Chacham Baruch Ben Haim say about wearing tefillin on Friday afternoon of a fast?
What does the book Tzadik Veshalom say about Mekubalim wearing tefillin on Friday fast days?
Did Rabbi Chayim Hakohen wear tefillin on Friday afternoons?
What was the original custom of Halab regarding tefillin at Minhah on fast days?
